title: The Pick That Split 181 Drafters 3 Ways | Pack One Latest Set | Pack One Daily 2026-10-26
body:
Latest Set · P1P7 · 2026-10-26

Prior picks: Tenured Tethermage, Craterclaw Colossus, Restore with Empathy, Konstrari Improviser, Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar, Skilled Battlecarver.

Of 181 distinct Pack One players:

• 40.9% chose Tam's Resistance (74 players)
• 35.9% chose Restore with Empathy (65 players)
• 16.6% chose Sureshot Sower (30 players)
• 12 chose other cards.

The original trophy drafter took Tam's Resistance. That was the choice of 40.9% of players.
